description: The DataGrid window WRITER (WIRE_FORMAT.md 3.2, "Row window and declared total", the paragraph "The window a viewport writes", Phase 1922). SELF-ENUMERATED, so the directory is one corpus family (27.7): `grid-window-writer`. grid-window-writer-vectors.json carries scripted sequences of viewport measurements with the expected write at every step, including the steps that write nothing. A host whose grid viewport writes the window descriptor runs every vector through its own pure writer and descriptor reader; a host with no grid viewport declares the family not applicable. Generated by generate.mjs beside it, which computes every expected answer from the specification's rules rather than from any host.
